namespace.name: LuGe.Common
namespace.p: The LuGe.Common namespace is the base for the LuGe Framework. It provide a base class for manipulating business object.
The namespace provides also an easy way to manage objects by reflection.

namespace.name: LuGe.Common.Collection
namespace.p: The LuGe.Common.Collection namespace provides different kind of generic collection.
Each collection can raise event when an item is added, removed or changed.
Items in the collection can be accessed using an integer index or a string key.

namespaces.namespace: The LuGe.Common.Data namespace provides classes for manipulating database.
The LuGe.Common.Data.SqlObject namespace provides classes for mapping datatable into dotNet object.
